method: fit all 12 DESI DR1 BAO numbers (full covariance) with flat ΛCDM; with 2-decimal and 3-decimal z_eff; with and without the z=0.51 bin
text: All DESI DR1 BAO: Ωm = 0.290 +0.015 -0.014 (MLE 0.289); the shift from DESI's 0.295 is due to z_eff rounding; without LRG 0.51: Ωm = 0.287 +0.016 -0.015 (MLE 0.286).
